description: This file contains utility functions for converting and copying filter scopes related to dashboard slices in the Apache Superset project. It defines functions to process filter metadata and manage immune slice references.

methods.name: convert_filter_scopes
methods.description: Converts filter metadata and slice information into a structured scope dictionary, handling immune slices and filter configurations.

methods.name: copy_filter_scopes
methods.description: Creates a new filter scope dictionary by remapping old slice IDs to new ones, updating immune references accordingly.
